rationale: Base station is online with uplink_status "ok" and all 7 devices online locally, yet E-503 (cloud reporting failed) persists after the standard L1 fix (base station restart + DNS set to automatic). Per the fault code reference and historical case H-06, E-503 persisting while the base station is online indicates a cloud channel or certificate issue that requires FAE escalation. The customer's mesh Wi-Fi change is not the cause since local operation and uplink are unaffected.
